interface.evidence: Original interface lists only a, b, c, d and q, each one bit.

semantics.behavior: Pure combinational even parity, no state or added latency.
semantics.initialization: At time 0, inputs 0000 imply q=1 after combinational delta settling; no reset or stored initial state.
semantics.evidence: Original states combinational circuit; waveform enumerates all 16 combinations from 0000 through 1111, with q=1 for even population count.

verification.oracle: Literal expected outputs transcribed from original waveform, independent of parity implementation.
verification.timing: Drive original rows at 0,5,10,15,20,...,90 ns; check after delta settling at the same timestamp.
verification.coverage: All original 19 rows, all 16 binary combinations, reverse-order truth-table replay to check history independence.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original waveform contains only binary inputs.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No X/Z acceptance requirement inferred; natural four-state XOR behavior is outside verified scope.
